Errors and limits

Source: vignettes/errors-and-limits.Rmd
errors-and-limits.Rmd

Versión en español: vignette("errors-and-limits-es", package = "ellmercodex").

library(ellmercodex)

ChatGPT plan usage is not the same as the OpenAI API: it is a preview with its own limits, and some API features are not available. This article lists what is not supported and shows how to handle errors in code that runs unattended, such as scheduled scripts or Shiny apps.

What is not supported

ellmercodex supports interactive use of one conversation at a time through ellmer’s Chat object (ellmer 0.5.0 or later). These are not supported:

  • parallel_chat() and batch_chat(). ChatGPT plan usage only works with streaming, so ellmer’s parallel and batch helpers are outside the supported scope.
  • Excluded request arguments. The preview rejects temperature, top_p, max_tokens (max_output_tokens), metadata, and previous_response_id, among others. ellmercodex fails before sending a request that uses them.
  • Provider token counting and file management. These fail before any request is sent.

Plan limits and supported features may change while the preview lasts.

Handle errors

ellmercodex signals structured conditions, so your code can react to the kind of error without parsing messages:

tryCatch(
  chat$chat("Hello"),
  codex_auth_error = function(error) {
    message("Authentication failed; run codex_login() again.")
  },
  codex_usage_limit_error = function(error) {
    message("The ChatGPT plan's usage limit was reached; try again later.")
  },
  codex_network_error = function(error) {
    message("Network error; check your connection and retry.")
  },
  codex_protocol_changed_error = function(error) {
    message("The upstream protocol may have changed; update ellmercodex.")
  },
  error = function(error) {
    message("The request failed: ", conditionMessage(error))
  }
)

Handle the most specific condition first. The main classes are:

  • codex_auth_error: the parent of all sign-in and credential errors, such as missing, malformed, or expired credentials.
  • Errors while talking to the service: codex_network_error, codex_authentication_error, codex_rate_limit_error, codex_server_error, codex_model_unavailable_error, codex_malformed_request_error, codex_protocol_error, and codex_protocol_changed_error, which means the shape of the service’s response may have changed.
  • ChatGPT plan errors, which also carry one of the classes above: codex_usage_limit_error (the plan’s usage limit was reached; also a codex_rate_limit_error), codex_usage_unavailable_error (plan usage is temporarily unavailable; also a codex_server_error), and codex_plan_ineligible_error (the account or workspace is not eligible; also a codex_authentication_error).
  • codex_chat_error and codex_chat_argument_error: problems on the ellmer side, such as an unsupported argument.

The full list is in ?ellmercodex-conditions.

What error messages contain

Messages are sanitized before they are signaled. They do not intentionally include raw response bodies, bearer tokens, authorization codes, OAuth state, account identifiers, or credential-store contents, so it is safe to log them.
